dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん……」
dialogues.en: "Niisan......"
dialogues.text: "Niisan......"

dialogues.jp:
どこかから音夢の声が聞こえる。もやの中、音
夢の声だけが、はっきりと耳にとどく。
dialogues.en:
I could hear Nemu's voice. I could only hear Nemu's voice
clearly.
dialogues.text:
I could hear Nemu's voice. I could only hear Nemu's voice
clearly.

dialogues.jp: このシチュエーションは……起こしにきたのか？
dialogues.en: Did she......come to wake me up?
dialogues.text: Did she......come to wake me up?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きてください」
dialogues.en: "Wake up, niisan."
dialogues.text: "Wake up, niisan."

dialogues.jp:
やっぱり、起こしにきたみたいだ。肩がおしと
やかにゆすられる。なんだか甘い声だ……。
dialogues.en:
She must have come to wake me up. She's shaking my shoulder.
She sounds sweeter than usual......
dialogues.text:
She must have come to wake me up. She's shaking my shoulder.
She sounds sweeter than usual......

dialogues.jp: （人前だからか？）
dialogues.en: (Is it because it's in front of the others?)
dialogues.text: (Is it because it's in front of the others?)

dialogues.jp: だが、それだと甘い声の説明にはならない。
dialogues.en: But, that doesn't explain it all.
dialogues.text: But, that doesn't explain it all.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「もう、仕方ないんだから……」
dialogues.en: "You're such a troublemaker......"
dialogues.text: "You're such a troublemaker......"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「目覚めのキスが必要かしら」
dialogues.en: "Do you need a kiss to wake up?"
dialogues.text: "Do you need a kiss to wake up?"

dialogues.jp: ――キス？
dialogues.en: ...A kiss?
dialogues.text: ...A kiss?

dialogues.jp:
（ちょっと待て！？　教室でソレはまずいだ
　ろ）
dialogues.en: (Wait a minute!? You can't do that in the classroom.)
dialogues.text: (Wait a minute!? You can't do that in the classroom.)

dialogues.jp: いや、教室でなくてもよくない。
dialogues.en: No, it's not okay even if we aren't in the classroom.
dialogues.text: No, it's not okay even if we aren't in the classroom.

dialogues.jp: （家で起こしてくれるときなら嬉しいけど）
dialogues.en: (I can't deny that I might not refuse it, if we're at home.)
dialogues.text: (I can't deny that I might not refuse it, if we're at home.)

dialogues.jp: ――詳しく言うならメチャ嬉しい。
dialogues.en: ---- I'd be very happy to be honest.
dialogues.text: ---- I'd be very happy to be honest.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ――」
dialogues.en: "Okay---"
dialogues.text: "Okay---"

dialogues.jp: ごく――。
dialogues.en: I hear the sound of swallowing ----
dialogues.text: I hear the sound of swallowing ----

dialogues.jp: 全神経をほっぺに集中させる。
dialogues.en: I focused on all the nerves in my cheek.
dialogues.text: I focused on all the nerves in my cheek.

dialogues.jp: （まさか、唇なんてことはないよな……）
dialogues.en: (She wouldn't do that to my lips, would she......?)
dialogues.text: (She wouldn't do that to my lips, would she......?)

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「覚悟しな！」
dialogues.en: "Get ready!"
dialogues.text: "Get ready!"

dialogues.en: ...What?
dialogues.text: ...What?

dialogues.jp: ――ガツンっ！！！！
dialogues.en: ---Smack!!!!
dialogues.text: ---Smack!!!!

dialogues.jp:
後頭部に、凄まじい衝撃を食らい、声にならな
い｛うめ／呻｝きが漏れる。
dialogues.en: I felt a throbbing pain on the back of my head and groaned.
dialogues.text: I felt a throbbing pain on the back of my head and groaned.

dialogues.jp: いきなり口調が変わって……頭が熱くて……。
dialogues.en:
The tone of her voice suddenly changed ......and my head's
hurting......
dialogues.text:
The tone of her voice suddenly changed ......and my head's
hurting......

dialogues.jp: キスは？
dialogues.en: What about the kiss?
dialogues.text: What about the kiss?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: （なにが起きたんだ？）
dialogues.en: (What happened?)
dialogues.text: (What happened?)

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん、起きましたか？」
dialogues.en: "Niisan, are you awake now?"
dialogues.text: "Niisan, are you awake now?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まったく、素直に起きなさいよね」
dialogues.en: "You should have woken up earlier."
dialogues.text: "You should have woken up earlier."

dialogues.jp:
何かの雑誌を手に持ちながら、眞子が呆れたよ
うに言う。
dialogues.en: Mako was standing there with a magazine in her hand.
dialogues.text: Mako was standing there with a magazine in her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「なにがあったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.jp: こんどは、声に出して尋ねる。
dialogues.en: I asked them.
dialogues.text: I asked them.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「兄さんがなかなか起きないので、眞子が手伝っ
　てくれたんです」
dialogues.en:
"Mako helped me to wake you up as you didn't wake up
easily."
dialogues.text:
"Mako helped me to wake you up as you didn't wake up
easily."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ホント、迷惑なヤツなんだから」
dialogues.en: "You're troublesome."
dialogues.text: "You're troublesome."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「そう思うなら、放っておけばいいだろう」
dialogues.en: "Why don't you leave me alone, did you think of that?"
dialogues.text: "Why don't you leave me alone, did you think of that?"

dialogues.jp: 頭がメチャ痛い。
dialogues.en: My head was hurting.
dialogues.text: My head was hurting.

dialogues.jp: 「いったいお前、何したんだ？」
dialogues.en: "What did you do?"
dialogues.text: "What did you do?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「別に。ただ、これを思いっきり振り下ろした
　だけ」
dialogues.en: "Nothing much. I just dropped this on to your head."
dialogues.text: "Nothing much. I just dropped this on to your head."

dialogues.jp:
眞子が手にした雑誌を｛・／縦｝にして、ギロチンの
ように振り下ろす仕草をする。
dialogues.en:
Mako made a gesture of dropping the magazine 'vertically'
like a guillotine.
dialogues.text:
Mako made a gesture of dropping the magazine 'vertically'
like a guillotine.

dialogues.jp: 俺を殺す気か？
dialogues.en: Is she trying to kill me?
dialogues.text: Is she trying to kill me?

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、あたしはもう行くから」
dialogues.en: "Okay, I'd better get going now."
dialogues.text: "Okay, I'd better get going now."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ええ、ありがとう眞子」
dialogues.en: "Thank you, Mako."
dialogues.text: "Thank you, Mako."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「いいって。……朝倉、あんまり音夢に苦労か
　けるなよ」
dialogues.en: "Never mind. ......Asakura, don't give Nemu any trouble."
dialogues.text: "Never mind. ......Asakura, don't give Nemu any trouble."

dialogues.jp: 離れていく眞子を見送り、音夢に視線を移す。
dialogues.en: I saw Mako walking away and then looked at Nemu.
dialogues.text: I saw Mako walking away and then looked at Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 「なぜ、お前が起こさなかったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why didn't you wake me up?"
dialogues.text: "Why didn't you wake me up?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「起こしました。兄さんが起きて下さらなかっ
　ただけです」
dialogues.en: "I tried, but you didn't wake up."
dialogues.text: "I tried, but you didn't wake up."

dialogues.jp: ……裏モードのお前で、起きるわけないだろう！
dialogues.en:
...How does she expect me to wake up with her pretending to
be such a sweetie pie?
dialogues.text:
...How does she expect me to wake up with her pretending to
be such a sweetie pie?

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「これからはちゃんと起きて下さいね。私では、
　兄さんを起こすのは大変なんですから」
dialogues.en:
"Please wake up next time. It's a hassle for me to wake you
up."
dialogues.text:
"Please wake up next time. It's a hassle for me to wake you
up."

dialogues.jp:
万人を｛あざむ／欺｝く、妹の笑顔に、俺は口をつぐむしか
なかった……。
dialogues.en: I couldn't say anything back to her fake smile......
dialogues.text: I couldn't say anything back to her fake smile......

dialogues.jp:
とりあえず、飯を食いに行こう。せっかく、命
懸けの起床を果たしたのだ。無駄にはできん。
dialogues.en:
I better go get something to eat. I woke up with my life on
the line. I should not waste it.
dialogues.text:
I better go get something to eat. I woke up with my life on
the line. I should not waste it.

dialogues.jp:
俺は席を立つと、生き残った脳細胞で、どこに
行くかを考える。
dialogues.en:
I stood up and thought about where to go with the rest of my
brain cells.
dialogues.text:
I stood up and thought about where to go with the rest of my
brain cells.

dialogues.jp: ◆音夢の夢◆
dialogues.en: ◆Dream about Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Dream about Nemu◆

dialogues.jp: 音夢の夢を見た。
dialogues.en: I had a dream about Nemu.
dialogues.text: I had a dream about Nemu.

dialogues.jp: 音夢が、俺を優しく起こしてくれる夢だ……。
dialogues.en: It was a dream about Nemu waking me up nicely......
dialogues.text: It was a dream about Nemu waking me up nicely......
